messages:
mia_cs: Opening Sandstone week0 onboarding thread. Blockers: KMS BYOK approval pending (CS-11420), egress to partner CIDR not permitted, and no audit events visible in their Splunk HEC. Can infra/security/ops pick owners?

raj_infra: I can handle firewall once we have CIDR+ports and which private subnets to scope. Also need whether traffic should go via NAT or VPC endpoint.

ellie_sec: For BYOK we need attestation doc + key ARN. Draft policy should scope usage to redwood-infra runtime and deny console decrypt. I'll post a minimal policy to the ticket shortly.

mia_cs: Customer provided partner endpoints: 54.210.33.0/24 port 443 and 54.210.34.8/29 port 8088 (Splunk). They want NAT GW. Subnets: sand-private-1, sand-private-2.

sam_ops: Quick Splunk HEC test (replace token):

```
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" -X POST https://splunk.sandstone.io:8088/services/collector/event -H "Authorization: Splunk <TOKEN>" -d '{"event":"test"}'
```

If you see 204 it's successful. Common issues: token mismatch or TLS/CA problems.

bot_deploy: priv-deploy/sandstone v0.1.0 smoke started at 3023456795. status: partial. failed: audit-forwarding,kms-policy

raj_infra: Created change request cr-721 to allow egress from sand-private-* to 54.210.33.0/24:443 and 54.210.34.8/29:8088 via ngw-9a7. ETA ~4m.

mia_cs: Sent BYOK attestation request to customer and asked them to regenerate HEC token for a quick test. AM alert: customer mentioned onboarding speed in renewal call. If KMS + audit not resolved in 72h escalate to AM/finance and mark as at-risk.

ellie_sec: Posted policy draft to CS-11420 limiting principal to arn:aws:iam::REDWOOD:role/redwood-priv and denying kms:Decrypt for console principals. Will update if customer BYOK attestation arrives.

sam_ops: After CR propagation please re-run curl. I'll also tail forwarder logs and upload snippet to ticket.

bot_deploy: Next check-in scheduled 3023533200 (week1). reaction :calendar:
